_note: Live-city demo data for user testing and the map: 18 photo-backed complaints along the Murthal-Sonipat corridor (Haryana). Not used for pitch metrics. 't' is minutes after the sim start (09:00). Each point is 'north_m'/'east_m' metres from a real place in app/places.py (OpenStreetMap), at most 300 m. Photos are CC-licensed stock photos in seed/photos (see ATTRIBUTION.md), not pictures of these places.

areas.title: Sonipat city: burst main outside Civil Hospital; sewage overflow at the bus stand and a related pothole

reports.text: Water pipeline burst on the road outside Civil Hospital, water gushing across SH20
Sewage overflowing from a manhole at the Sonipat bus stand entrance
Road caving in on NH352A just past the Sonipat bus stand, buses swerving around it

areas.title: GT Road (NH-44): lights out at the Rishihood University gate (two reports); fallen tree and potholes at Bahalgarh; a leak on the service lane

reports.text: Streetlights out on the GT Road service lane by the Rishihood University gate, one pole bent
Service lane near the university gate is completely dark at night, lights not working
Tree fallen across the Bahalgarh road after last night's storm, blocking one lane
Row of potholes on the GT Road stretch at Bahalgarh, water filling them
Water line leaking under the GT Road service lane south of the university, lane waterlogged

areas.title: Murthal: garbage behind the dhabas (two reports, sanitation crew on leave), a choked drain, a pothole at Murthal Chowk

reports.text: Garbage dumped behind the Murthal dhabas on GT Road for three days
Heap of food waste and plastic next to the dhaba parking in Murthal
Drain choked behind the Murthal dhabas, dirty water spilling onto the lane
Deep pothole at Murthal Chowk on SH20, a scooter nearly had an accident here

areas.title: Sonipat: railway station garbage (no sanitation crew) and open drain; Sector 15 lights, leak and a fallen tree; broken drain cover in the city centre

reports.text: Garbage piled along the road outside Sonipat Junction railway station
Open drain overflowing next to the station road, smell everywhere
Streetlights not working on the Sector 15 market road for a week
Supply line leaking near the Sector 15 park, water standing on the lane by the hand pump
Big tree uprooted on the Sector 15 inner road, branches on parked cars
Drain cover broken in the Sonipat city centre footpath, open hole full of rubbish
